### 3. Quick Glow aur All-Skin Types ke liye:

  *   * **Key Ingredients:[www.dermatocare.com](https://www.dermatocare.com/best-vitamin-c-serum-india-dermatologist-recommended/#:~:text=Key%20ing%3A%2010%25%20Ethyl%20Ascorbic%20Acid%20%2B,Skin%20brightening%3A%205%25%20Niacinamide%20%2B%20Alpha%20Arbutin.)** Pure L-Ascorbic Acid + Vitamin E[www.forbes.com](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/best-vitamin-c-serum/#:~:text=It%20evens%20out%20pigmentation%20and%20fights%20against,spots%20and%20a%20more%20youthful%20appearance%20overall.)
  * **Fayde:[www.dermatocare.com](https://www.dermatocare.com/best-vitamin-c-serum-india-dermatologist-recommended/#:~:text=10%25%20Vitamin%20C%20blend%20%2B%20ferulic%20acid,C%20Brightening%20Serum.%20Applying.%20Dermatocare%20Rating%E2%9C%A8%20%284.3)** Agar aapko jaldi results chahiye aur skin par dullness bohot zyada hai, toh yeh potent formula skin ko turant bright banata hai.

---

### Kuch Zaroori Tips:

1.  **Patch Test Zaroor Karein:** Chehre par lagane se pehle kaan ke piche ya haath par thoda sa laga kar 24 ghante check kar lein ki koi allergy toh nahi ho rahi.
2.  **Sunscreen Hai Zaroori:** Subh Vitamin C lagane ke baad din mein **Sunscreen** lagana bilkul na bhulein, nahi toh sunlight ki wajah se dark spots aur zyada dark ho sakte hain.
3.  **Storage:** Vitamin C serums jaldi oxidize (kharab) ho jate hain, isliye inhe thandi aur andhere jagah par (ho sake toh fridge mein) rakhein.

1.  **Patch Test Zaroor Karein:** Chehre par lagane se pehle kaan ke piche ya haath par thoda sa laga kar 24 ghante check kar lein ki koi allergy toh nahi ho rahi.
2.  **Sunscreen Hai Zaroori:** Subh Vitamin C lagane ke baad din mein **Sunscreen** lagana bilkul na bhulein, nahi toh sunlight ki wajah se dark spots aur zyada dark ho sakte hain.
3.  **Storage:** Vitamin C serums jaldi oxidize (kharab) ho jate hain, isliye inhe thandi aur andhere jagah par (ho sake toh fridge mein) rakhein.
